entry.summary:
Machine-translated from the original Telegram post.

Source: @hesmashena

The second issue of the specialized quarterly of the Payab Think Tank has been published.

🔴The Payab Quarterly, produced by the Payab Think Tank, aims to publish the opinions and initiatives of scholars in the fields of foreign policy, international relations, policymaking, and governance, following the style of journals based on policy reports.

🔷The editorial of this issue of the Payab Quarterly, titled "Political Psychology and International Relations," was written by Dr. Abbas Maleki, editor-in-chief of the Payab journal.

🔻This quarterly also features articles and notes including "The New Architecture of Strategic Relations with China and Russia: Authenticity and Comprehensive Capacity" by Dr. Mohammad Javad Zarif, "Sitting in Falsehood; or Wandering in the Wilderness? In Defense of Peaceful Nuclear Technology and a Third Way for Iran's National Security" by Dr. Hesamoddin Ashena, "Policymaking in Implementation; Rethinking Governance, Investment, and the Development of Iran's Oil and Gas Industry" by Dr. Gholamreza Manouchehri, "The Strait of Hormuz and the Dispute over Iranian Management" by Dr. Kourosh Ahmadi, "Foreign Policy and the Harmful Cycle of Decision-Making Expectation in Crisis Conditions" by Dr. Sasan Karimi, and "The Delegated and Unpredictable Iranian" by Dr. Seyed Jafar Hashemi.

🔻In the policy reports section, works have been published by Dr. Kiumars Ashtarian titled "The Right to Geography," Dr. Omid Asghari titled "Southophobia, the Right to Development, and Global Governance," Dr. Shafaei and Dr. Tabatabainejad titled "From the Strategy of Resistance to the Architecture of a New Order: The Question of Sustainable National Security," Dr. Mohammad Fekri titled "Opportunities and Risks of Post-War Street Gatherings," and Dr. Mohsen Shalbaf titled "The Rise of the Green Superpower; How Did China Surpass Europe and America in the Transition to Clean Technologies?"

🔻Further in the second issue of the Payab Quarterly, works by Amin Hasani, Amirparsa Garmsiri, Kasra Ghafouri, Mahya Danesh, Fatemeh Sadeghi Sheikh, and Ali Faryadras are also featured.

♦️The specialized Payab Quarterly, at 162 pages, is available for access and use by all interested parties on the Payab Think Tank website at www.paiab.org
